description:
Tailored For Kids: The stem of the EV06C electric scooter for kids can be adjusted between 0 - 8 inches at will, and the handlebars height is 29 - 37 inches.In addition, the maximum load is 132 LBS, which means that this e-scooter is tailor-made for children aged 6-12.

3 Gear & Led Display: 3 MPH - 6 MPH - 9.3 MPH three speed modes can be adjusted for children to ride, and the maximum mileage can reach 5 miles. Equipped with an LED display on the thumb throttle, kids can know the current speed, current speed mode and battery level.

Lighting & Braking System: EV06C is equipped with a stylish colorful light system. When the light switch is turned on, not only the EVERCROSS LOGO will be illuminated on the footboard, but the LED breathing light strips will also flash in the stem. Besides, we also use "Electronic Brake" method to ensure the safety of children.

Foldable & Portable: Due to the advanced one-step folding system, children can fold by themselves without the help of parents. The lightweight design of 22 LBS makes it easy for kids to carry the scooter up and down the stairs, which reduces a lot of burden for parents.
Surprising & Ideal Gift: When the children's birthday, Children's Day, Christmas and other festivals come, give the children this electric scooter as a gift, it will be a delicate, unique and exquisite surprise for them. When your child rides this el...ectric scooter among friends, he will be the most fashionable and awesome kid !
NOTE: The kids scooter must be traveling at least 3 MPH before motor will engage. And data may vary due to different speed mode, weight load, battery, temperature, road conditions, etc.
